faq.question: What CAD and BIM formats do you work with?
faq.answer: BIM submissions in Singapore need to adhere to CORENETX BIM e-submission standards. Our BIM Managers ensure that BIM models are created in the IFC-SG format.

faq.question: Do you handle BIM submissions to CORENETX?
faq.answer: Our BIM Managers have extensive experience working on CORENETX BIM e-submissions. While we can prepare the models, the final submission on CORENET is the responsibility of a Qualified Person or Architect.

faq.question: Do I need to buy ACC/ProjectWise/BIM Collaborate Pro licenses?
faq.answer: Our BIM Managers are equipped with the latest BIM CDE software and tools for 3D / 4D / 5D / 6D BIM coordination. We can work with your existing software or provide our own licenses.

faq.question: Is onsite support available?
faq.answer: When you engage our BIM Management services, we are available to schedule a visit to your site on short notice.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: To begin, please provide the base BIM models (if available) from the project consultant or engineer. Additionally, share all relevant 2D and 3D files related to your scope of work.

faq.question: Can we need to sign an NDA?
faq.answer: All our BIM/CAD Managers are bound by an NDA. We are happy to sign an additional NDA if required.
